original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-duality-proper-over-field}
Let $X$ be a proper scheme over a field $k$. There exists a dualizing complex
$\omega_X^\bullet$ with the following properties
\begin{enumerate}
\item $H^i(\omega_X^\bullet)$ is nonzero only for $i \in [-\dim(X), 0]$,
\item $\omega_X = H^{-\dim(X)}(\omega_X^\bullet)$ is a coherent
$(S_2)$-module whose support is the irreducible components
of dimension $\dim(X)$,
\item the dimension of the support of $H^i(\omega_X^\bullet)$ is at most $-i$,
\item for $x \in X$ closed the module
$H^i(\omega_{X, x}^\bullet) \oplus \ldots \oplus H^0(\omega_{X, x}^\bullet)$
is nonzero if and only if $\text{depth}(\mathcal{O}_{X, x}) \leq -i$,
\item for $K \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X)$ there are functorial
isomorphisms\footnote{This property
characterizes $\omega_X^\bullet$ in $D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X)$
up to unique isomorphism by the Yoneda lemma. Since $\omega_X^\bullet$
is in $D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_X)$ in fact it suffices to consider
$K \in D^b_{\textit{Coh}}(\mathcal{O}_X)$.}
$$
\Ext^i_X(K, \omega_X^\bullet) = \Hom_k(H^{-i}(X, K), k)
$$
compatible with shifts and distinguished triangles,
\item there are functorial isomorphisms
$\Hom(\mathcal{F}, \omega_X) = \Hom_k(H^{\dim(X)}(X, \mathcal{F}), k)$
for $\mathcal{F}$ quasi-coherent on $X$, and
\item if $X \to \Spec(k)$ is smooth of relative dimension $d$,
then $\omega_X^\bullet \cong \wedge^d\Omega_{X/k}[d]$ and
$\omega_X \cong \wedge^d\Omega_{X/k}$.
\end{enumerate}
stage_b_review_note: Source at duality.tex line 6716 gives seven individually scoped consequences for a dualizing complex on a proper k-scheme: degree [-dimX,0], highest-dimensional S2 canonical module, support bounds, the closed-point depth condition, full global Ext/field-duality, the sheaf statement for quasi-coherent F, and smooth top exterior differential form. The reconstruction keeps these seven assertions, the degree signs, and the proper-over-field hypothesis.
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a proper finite-type $k$-scheme of Krull dimension $d$. Let $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $a_p$ be the right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$, where $Rp_*$ identifies with derived global sections $R\Gamma(X,-)$. Define the *canonical normalized dualizing complex* $D_X=a_p(k[0])$; it is the compactification-based $p^!k$. Put $\omega_X=H^{-d}(D_X)$ and let $t:H^0(X,D_X)\to k$ be the cohomological trace induced by the adjunction counit $R\Gamma(X,D_X)\to k$. Then the dualizing complex $D_X$ satisfies: (1) $H^i(D_X)=0$ outside $[-d,0]$; (2) $\omega_X$ is coherent, satisfies Serre $(S_2)$, and is supported precisely on the irreducible components of $X$ of dimension $d$; (3) $\dim\operatorname{Supp}H^i(D_X)\le-i$; (4) at any *closed* point $x$ and any integer $i$, the direct sum $\bigoplus_{j=i}^{0}H^j((D_X)_x)$ is nonzero iff $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{X,x}\le-i$ (with the empty-sum convention when $i>0$); (5) for all $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ and integers $i$, $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(K,D_X)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^{-i}(R\Gamma(X,K)),k)$ functorially, compatibly with shifts and triangles; (6) for any quasi-coherent $\mathcal F$ on $X$, $\operatorname{Hom}_X(\mathcal F,\omega_X)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^d(X,\mathcal F),k)$ naturally; (7) if $p$ is smooth of relative dimension $d$, then $D_X\simeq(\bigwedge^d\Omega_{X/k})[d]$ and $\omega_X\simeq\bigwedge^d\Omega_{X/k}$. Here $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(K,D_X)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(X)}(K,D_X[i])$; in (5) the result identifies one vector space with the linear dual of the other, not necessarily a symmetric perfect pairing for arbitrary unbounded $K$.
hypotheses: X proper over field k, d=dim X, D_X defined as right-adjoint image of k with trace.
conclusions: Seven dualizing amplitude, S2, depth, field-Ext and smooth canonical bundle claims.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-duality-proper-over-field-perfect}
Let $k$, $X$, and $\omega_X^\bullet$
be as in Lemma \ref{lemma-duality-proper-over-field}.
Let $t : H^0(X, \omega_X^\bullet) \to k$ be as in
Remark \ref{remark-duality-proper-over-field}.
Let $E \in D(\mathcal{O}_X)$ be perfect. Then the pairings
$$
H^i(X, \omega_X^\bullet \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} E^\vee)
\times
H^{-i}(X, E) \longrightarrow k, \quad
(\xi, \eta) \longmapsto
t((1_{\omega_X^\bullet} \otimes \epsilon)(\xi \cup \eta))
$$
are perfect for all $i$. Here $\cup$ denotes the cup product
of Cohomology, Section \ref{cohomology-section-cup-product} and
$\epsilon : E^\vee \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} E \to \mathcal{O}_X$
is as in Cohomology, Example \ref{cohomology-example-dual-derived}.
stage_b_review_note: At line 6860 the source assumes E PERFECT and uses derived dual, cup product, evaluation and trace to obtain degree-i pairing H^i(ω⊗E^vee) × H^{-i}(E)→k perfect for all i. The reconstruction retains both indices and the perfectness requirement, rather than extending finite-dimensional perfect pairing to arbitrary complexes.
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a proper finite-type $k$-scheme of Krull dimension $d$. Let $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $a_p$ be the right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$, where $Rp_*$ identifies with derived global sections $R\Gamma(X,-)$. Define the *canonical normalized dualizing complex* $D_X=a_p(k[0])$; it is the compactification-based $p^!k$. Put $\omega_X=H^{-d}(D_X)$ and let $t:H^0(X,D_X)\to k$ be the cohomological trace induced by the adjunction counit $R\Gamma(X,D_X)\to k$. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be a perfect complex, with derived dual $E^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_X(E,\mathcal O_X)$ and evaluation $\epsilon:E^\vee\otimes_X^{\mathbf L}E\to\mathcal O_X$. For each $i\in\mathbf Z$, the cup product, then evaluation, then trace $t$ defines a bilinear pairing
\[
H^i(X,D_X\otimes_X^{\mathbf L}E^\vee)\times H^{-i}(X,E)\to k.
\]
Each pairing is *perfect*: the two cohomology groups are finite-dimensional over $k$ and identify with each other's linear duals. The claim uses perfectness of $E$ and properness of $X$ and does not extend blindly to arbitrary unbounded quasi-coherent $E$.
hypotheses: X proper/k, D_X right-adjoint dualizing, E perfect, trace t.
conclusions: Relative cup/evaluation/trace gives perfect field pairings for every cohomological degree.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-duality-proper-over-field-CM}
Let $X$ be a proper scheme over a field $k$ which is Cohen-Macaulay
and equidimensional of dimension $d$. The module $\omega_X$
of Lemma \ref{lemma-duality-proper-over-field} has the following properties
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\omega_X$ is a dualizing module on $X$
(Section \ref{section-dualizing-module}),
\item $\omega_X$ is a coherent Cohen-Macaulay module whose support is $X$,
\item there are functorial isomorphisms
$\Ext^i_X(K, \omega_X[d]) = \Hom_k(H^{-i}(X, K), k)$
compatible with shifts and distinguished triangles for $K \in D_\QCoh(X)$,
\item there are functorial isomorphisms
$\Ext^{d - i}(\mathcal{F}, \omega_X) = \Hom_k(H^i(X, \mathcal{F}), k)$
for $\mathcal{F}$ quasi-coherent on $X$.
\end{enumerate}
stage_b_review_note: At line 6888 the source assumes proper, Cohen–Macaulay, EQUIDIMENSIONAL X/k with dimension d. Its four conclusions are dualizing module, coherent CM full support, Ext^i(K,ω[d]) duality and Ext^{d-i}(F,ω) duality; the draft retains their degrees, naturality and global Ext nature.
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a proper finite-type $k$-scheme of Krull dimension $d$. Let $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $a_p$ be the right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}$, where $Rp_*$ identifies with derived global sections $R\Gamma(X,-)$. Define the *canonical normalized dualizing complex* $D_X=a_p(k[0])$; it is the compactification-based $p^!k$. Put $\omega_X=H^{-d}(D_X)$ and let $t:H^0(X,D_X)\to k$ be the cohomological trace induced by the adjunction counit $R\Gamma(X,D_X)\to k$. Suppose $X$ is additionally Cohen–Macaulay and equidimensional of dimension $d$, and set $\omega_X=H^{-d}(D_X)$. Then $D_X\simeq\omega_X[d]$, and (1) $\omega_X$ is a dualizing module on $X$ (the lowest cohomology of its dualizing complex); (2) $\omega_X$ is coherent and Cohen–Macaulay as a module, supported on all of $X$; (3) for any $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ and integer $i$, $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(K,\omega_X[d])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^{-i}(X,K),k)$ naturally and compatibly with shifts and distinguished triangles; (4) for any quasi-coherent $\mathcal F$, $\operatorname{Ext}^{d-i}_X(\mathcal F,\omega_X)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(H^i(X,\mathcal F),k)$ naturally. All Ext groups are *global derived Ext*, not sheaf Ext.
hypotheses: X proper CM equidimensional over field k, D_X relative dualizing, d=dim X.
conclusions: Canonical module coherent CM with full support and two forms of Serre duality.
